Title
- Concise, imperative summary (e.g., "Add X to do Y")

Summary
- What changed and why? Link related issues.

Problem
- What problem does this solve? User story or bug description.

Solution
- How did you solve it? Key design decisions and tradeoffs.

Testing
- Test plan and results (unit, integration, manual). Include commands run.

Screenshots/Recordings
- UI before/after or API examples if applicable.

Risks
- Potential regressions or impacts. How mitigated?

Rollback plan
- How to disable/revert if issues arise.

Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing locally
- [ ] Docs updated (CLAUDE.md, docs/*, README if needed)
- [ ] Lint/type checks passing (where configured)
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data included
